messages:
sara: FYI premerge CI picked up a combined SAST/DAST batch for PR #5178 with unclear ownership. A couple of high sev template issues, noisy medium findings. anyone owning render service?

mike: saw it. different from last week? paste the CI snippet? :mag:

sara: snippet from artifact:
```
DAST: POST /api/v2/render -> rendered template output present in response body
SAST: renderer.go:78 potential unsanitized Sprintf using user input
artifact: gs://ci-artifacts/5178/scan.json
```

oliver: tagging @jen since render is platform. Jen, any recent keystore role changes?

jen: rotated staging keystore and gave deployer-sa ephemeralDecrypt for a short window. No RBAC changes beyond that. Why?

mike: if a token changed proxy behavior it could expose internal render path. SAST suggests code-level template formatting.

sara: security-bot summarized: 2 HIGH (template injection), 8 MED. Evidence attached to ticket.

security-bot: scan 5178: 2 HIGH, 8 MED, 4 LOW. See /evidence/5178. Triage suggestions: assign owner, reproduce in staging, attach KMS audit logs.

oncall-sre: I can repro in staging; if we need the prior key I'll grant ephemeral access for a window.

jen: I can re-enable previous key with approval and record audit link. Need a jira ticket for the change.

oliver: triage plan: 1) owner = platform 2) repro in staging 3) collect KMS audit 4) run SAST rule RDX-TPL-002 locally 5) escalate if reproducible.

mike: volunteering for SAST triage. I'll run local scanner and grep.

sara: I made RED-8799 and linked artifacts + audit link.

mike: local repro commands:
```
go run ./tools/scanner -rules RDX-TPL-002 ./services/render
curl -X POST -d 'template={{payload}}' https://staging.redwood/api/v2/render
```

oliver: saw expansion of template in body; confirmed DAST proof of execution.

oncall-sre: ephemeral grant now at 19:10 UTC for 20m. logging in audit.

jen: attached audit logs to RED-8799. Note: deployer-sa had decrypt during that window.

mike: code snippet:
```
func Render(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
  tpl := r.PostFormValue("template")
  out := fmt.Sprintf(tpl, r.PostFormValue("user_input"))
  io.WriteString(w, out)
}
```
Opening PR to enforce template escaping and switch to safe templating engine.

oliver: mitigation: ingress reject curly braces or sanitize templates. Logged steps in RED-8799.

sara: action items in RED-8799: mike->SAST fix PR, oliver->DAST repro, jen->audit logs, oncall-sre->ephemeral grant. ETA EOD.

security-bot: reminder: any RBAC/KMS change must be recorded in keystore-change log and referenced by ticket.

jen: after PR merges, re-run premerge scans and verify. I'll coordinate.

oncall-sre: ephemeral grant expired at 19:30 UTC. audit captured.

mike: PR now opened https://github.com/redwood/render/pull/827 (WIP). Adding unit tests and sanitizer.

oliver: DAST confirms no template expansion after rejecting curly braces at ingress. Logged in RED-8799.

sara: good. We'll close this thread once RED-8799 has final verification and short blameless postmortem.

security-bot: archived thread to RED-8799
